name: 02657 · Provincetown, MA
findings: ZIP 02657 (Provincetown) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02657 (Provincetown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02657 (Provincetown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 15% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
